title: StageForge show, version 12
description: Open StageForge show with ordered cues, preview fade timing, an optional deterministic authored crowd, the current desk, optional timed playback, MVR interchange, SMPTE metadata, real equipment catalogue references, rigging/power specifications, and audio-reactive fixture/control mappings (look.audioMap). Cross-field rules are also checked by the reader, including crowd ID uniqueness, real theatre seat references, exclusion and placement clearance, venue and height bounds, deterministic generator limits, valid cue and rig references, ordered event times, motor limits, fixture limits, power references, and audio mapping targets.

activeCueId.description: Null, or an ID from cues.

cueFade.description: Recorded preview-only beam/wash transition. Duration 0 is reserved for interrupting an active recorded fade.

focusMarkId.description: An available platform:<id> focus point, audience, or null.
An available platform:<id> focus point, audience, or null.

cueState.description: Only supplied desk fields change when firing a cue. Each supplied subsystem is a complete object.

podTargets.description: Keys must match truss pod IDs in the rig.

customMediaUrl.description: Session media must be selected again after opening the file.

followSeconds.description: Seconds to hold before advancing to the following cue. Omit for a manual hold.

fadeSeconds.description: Seconds for the destination cue's preview beam/wash fade. Omit or use 0 for a cut.

mediaName.description: Display name or basename only. Use an empty string when no source is selected. Media bytes, device credentials, paths and URLs are never embedded.

demoStep.description: Position in sixteenth notes of the built-in 64-bar score.

event.description: Apply supplied changes in file order. A cueId records the historical cue label and can refer to a deleted cue. The stored look supplies the actual state.

initialEvent.description: The first event is a complete initial snapshot at zero milliseconds.

events.description: Ordered by nondecreasing atMs. Each atMs must be at most durationMs. Empty recordings are permitted.

timecodeOffsetMs.description: Optional SMPTE start offset in milliseconds (e.g. 3600000 for 01:00:00:00).

hangs.description: Omit to inherit the speaker arrays from the rig. An empty list explicitly removes all hangs.

smpteFrameRate.description: SMPTE timecode frame rate. 29.97 denotes 29.97 drop-frame (DF) as encoded by MTC and Art-Net OpTimeCode.
